_source.name: Additions beyond Second Harvest: CAP OC Food Bank partners, city pages, org sites, aggregators
_source.note: Each item's url is its schedule source. _confidence: high = org/city page; medium = org page with partial info or a recent directory.

_verify_before_running: Set _shellId before running. Seed 'items' only; '_needsConfirmation' is low-confidence (undated or 2024 lists, conflicting times) and should be called before seeding.
lat/lng null (Census geocoder no match): City of Irvine Food Box (Great Park Lot 2), Mariners Church Irvine, The Neighborhood Feeding Program (Buena Park). Needs manual geocode.
Seva Collective: biweekly RRULE anchored on Nov 8, 2025 (city notice). Any skipped week shifts the cadence; confirm on their social media.
Vineyard Laguna Niguel: only check-in times published; 1-hour end assumed (_endTimeAssumed).
Westminster Senior Center lunch: only 11:30 start published; 12:30 end assumed.
VACF 1st Saturday drive-thru: times from a May 2025 event page. Same vendorSlug as the existing Vital Access Care Foundation entries so it groups with them.
Oak View FRC: appointment by phone Monday after 11 AM for Friday pickup.
Mariners Church Irvine is a different site from the Mariners Anaheim/HB/Santa Ana entries already seeded.
Senior lunches (Santa Ana x2, Westminster) are hot meals for 60+, not grocery pickups; category 'Senior Meals'.
_conventions: Same as the Second Harvest file: local Pacific 24h times, start/end = first occurrence on or after 2026-09-18, RFC 5545 RRULE.
_dedupe_notes: Dropped as already in dataset: Faith Deliverance Apostolic Church (Fullerton), The Bridge Building / Bell Tower RSM Cares (same address and schedule), St. Isidore Plaza = Heart of the City (Los Alamitos), His Pantry HB (likely His Place Church).
Skipped: UCI Basic Needs pantry (students only), Guidestone Church and Lighthouse Outreach (listed hours look like office hours), Garden Grove Church of God (dates TBA).
_noPublishedSchedule_CAPOC_partners: About 110 CAP OC partner sites list no days or times anywhere public (e.g. Mary's Kitchen, Access California Services, Templo Calvario, Crescent Food Bank, Bethany Bible Fellowship). They'd need a phone pass or 211OC.
